datasets.name: 1e8f1dc5
queryLines:
SELECT electoral_district, political_party,
       total_amount, contribution_count, unique_contributors,
       ROUND(total_amount / unique_contributors, 2) AS avg_per_contributor,
       CASE
         WHEN total_amount / unique_contributors > 1500 THEN 'High Avg'
         WHEN unique_contributors = 1 AND total_amount > 1000 THEN 'Single Donor'
         ELSE 'Normal'
       END AS anomaly_flag
FROM pfin_dev.gold.contributions_by_district
WHERE electoral_district != 'National / No District'
  AND array_contains(:fiscal_year, fiscal_year)
ORDER BY avg_per_contributor DESC

datasets.name: f3f46a23
queryLines:
SELECT contribution_count_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS contributor_count,
       SUM(total_contributed) AS total_dollars
FROM (
  SELECT cn.contributor_key,
         COUNT(*) AS num_contributions,
         SUM(cn.total_amount) AS total_contributed,
         CASE
           WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '1. Single'
           WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2. Occasional (2–5)'
           WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '3. Regular (6–10)'
           ELSE '4. Frequent (10+)'
         END AS contribution_count_bucket
  FROM pfin_dev.silver.contributions cn
  JOIN pfin_dev.silver.electoral_events e ON cn.electoral_event_key = e.electoral_event_key
  GROUP BY cn.contributor_key
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.contributor_name,
       COALESCE(c.contributor_province, 'Unknown') AS province,
       e.fiscal_year,
       COUNT(*) AS num_contributions,
       SUM(cn.total_amount) AS total_contributed,
       ROUND(AVG(cn.total_amount), 2) AS avg_per_contribution
FROM pfin_dev.silver.contributions cn
JOIN pfin_dev.silver.contributors c ON cn.contributor_key = c.contributor_key
JOIN pfin_dev.silver.electoral_events e ON cn.electoral_event_key = e.electoral_event_key
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING SUM(cn.total_amount) BETWEEN 500 AND 50000
   AND COUNT(*) <= 50
ORDER BY total_contributed DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT CASE
         WHEN contribution_count = 1 THEN 'One-Time Donor'
         ELSE 'Repeat Donor'
       END AS donor_type,
       fiscal_year,
       COUNT(*) AS donor_count,
       SUM(total_amount) AS total_contributed,
       ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM (
  SELECT cn.contributor_key,
         e.fiscal_year,
         COUNT(*) AS contribution_count,
         SUM(cn.total_amount) AS total_amount
  FROM pfin_dev.silver.contributions cn
  JOIN pfin_dev.silver.electoral_events e ON cn.electoral_event_key = e.electoral_event_key
  GROUP BY cn.contributor_key, e.fiscal_year
)
GROUP BY 1, 2

queryLines:

       COUNT(*) AS num_contributions,
       CASE WHEN e.fiscal_year = 2025 THEN 1750 ELSE 1775 END AS annual_limit,

FROM pfin_dev.silver.contributions cn

HAVING SUM(cn.total_amount) > CASE WHEN e.fiscal_year = 2025 THEN 1750 ELSE 1775 END

datasets.name: 7a9d237a
queryLines:
WITH contributor_party_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.contributor_name,
    COALESCE(c.contributor_province, 'Unknown') AS province,
    e.fiscal_year,
    r.political_party,
    COUNT(*) AS num_contributions_to_party,
    SUM(cn.total_amount) AS total_to_party
  FROM
    pfin_dev.silver.contributions cn
      JOIN pfin_dev.silver.contributors c
        ON cn.contributor_key = c.contributor_key
      JOIN pfin_dev.silver.recipients r
        ON cn.recipient_id = r.recipient_id
      JOIN pfin_dev.silver.electoral_events e
        ON cn.electoral_event_key = e.electoral_event_key
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4
),
contributor_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    contributor_name,
    province,
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(total_to_party) AS grand_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT political_party) AS parties_count,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(political_party))) AS parties_list,
    SUM(num_contributions_to_party) AS num_contributions
  FROM
    contributor_party_totals
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
)
SELECT
  contributor_name,
  province,
  fiscal_year,
  grand_total,
  parties_count,
  parties_list,
  num_contributions
FROM
  contributor_rollup
WHERE
  parties_count > 1
  AND grand_total
    > CASE
      WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN 1750
      ELSE 1775
    END
ORDER BY
  grand_total DESC

frame.title: Anomaly Distribution: Districts by Avg. Contribution

lines:
**Key takeaways**

* **Unknown** (top-left, gray): **Few donors** but an **extremely high average contribution** (\~$10K+). These are contributors with **no province on file** making **large donations**, which is worth investigating.
* **Ontario** (far right, pink): **The most donors** (\~50K) but a **lower average contribution**. This suggests **high volume** with **smaller donation amounts**.
* **British Columbia** and **Alberta** (middle): **Moderate donor counts** with **moderate average contributions**.
* **New Brunswick**, **Nova Scotia**, and **Saskatchewan** (bottom-left cluster): **Fewer donors** and **lower average contributions**.

**How to read this chart:** Each cell shows **total contributions** for a **province–party pair**. **Darker blue** indicates **higher contribution totals**; **lighter blue** indicates **lower totals**.
